storyboardBeats.narration: That tire light in August might be heat, not a warning.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro, dashboard TPMS warning icon glowing amber, shallow depth of field, slight handheld-style micro-shake, hot afternoon sunlight glare through a windshield, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Air expands with heat — about 1 PSI for every 10 degrees. Drive on hot asphalt and your reading climbs.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a tire pressure gauge needle rising, mounted on a tire valve stem in bright midday sun, heat-shimmer visible off dark asphalt in the background, slow push-in, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Check it hot midday and it looks fine. Check it again cold the next morning, and it can read several PSI low.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Split-feel single shot: same tire valve stem and gauge, warm golden midday light dissolving into cooler blue early-morning light via a slow lighting transition, static camera, time-of-day contrast, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Underinflated on a hot highway is exactly when a tire is most likely to overheat.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a tire sidewall flexing under load on hot pavement, slow lateral tracking shot alongside a moving wheel well, heat-haze practical effect, motion blur on the road surface, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Check pressure cold, before you drive. Or stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire and Auto — link in bio.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door open to bright summer daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
